verdicts.decision_note: The client authorizes the financial model to use documented indicative opex ranges and requires all resulting assumptions to be flagged.
The freelancer identifies a material 11-fold conflict between two possible full-network opex inputs that requires a client decision.
The client sets the executable full-network opex input to CAD 48–64M per year and prohibits use of the understated Appendix amount; no prior attribute must be removed.
The client resolves the material opex-input conflict, allowing modeling to proceed with the confirmed range.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that cost lines are calculated separately from their own assumptions rather than entered as one lump sum.
